title: Kehte hain sarwar yahi meri kamar toot gayi
body:
Kehte Hain Sarwar Yahi, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
margaya Sher E Jari, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
Tum To Meri Jaan The Mere Nigehbaan The
tum Se Meri Aas Thi, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaqri Tera Salaam Jab Se Hai Maine Suna
ruk Si Gayi Zindagi, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
Baap Ka Saaya Mere Sar Se Utha Aaj Phir
dekhiye Baba Ali, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Bole Jari Uth Nahi Sakta Mai Tazeem Ko.
haaye Yeh Sharmindagi, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
Jab Bhi Pukaara Mujhe Aaqa O Moula Kaha.
bhai Pukaaro Aqi, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Bin Tere Bhai Mere Kaise Mai Jee Paaunga.
mujh Pe Chalegi Churi, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
Aaj Bhi Jab Taziya Uthta Hai Mirza Kahi
kehte Hain Ibne Ali, Meri Kamar Toot Gayi
